title: From System 1 to System 2: A Survey of Reasoning Large Language Models
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI), 2025
authors_zh: Zhong-Zhi Li, Duzhen Zhang, Ming-Liang Zhang, Jiaxin Zhang, Zengyan Liu, Yuxuan Yao, Haotian Xu, Junhao Zheng, Pei-Jie Wang, Xiuyi Chen, Yingying Zhang, Fei Yin, Jiahua Dong, Zhiwei Li, Bao-Long Bi, Ling-Rui Mei, Junfeng Fang, Xiao Liang, Zhijiang Guo, Le Song, Cheng-Lin Liu
paper_type_zh: 推理大模型综述与资源索引
best_for_zh: 需要选择推理数据配方、验证机制或评测基准的研究者。
one_line: Surveys the transition from fast System 1-style LLM behavior to deliberate reasoning LLMs, organizing construction methods, benchmarks, metrics, and open challenges.
以 System 1 到 System 2 为主线，梳理推理大模型的构建方法、基准、指标与开放问题。
why: It supplies a cross-method map before readers choose a reasoning-data recipe, a verifier, or an evaluation benchmark.
inclusion_reason: Maps System-2-style reasoning methods, benchmarks, evaluation metrics, and open research gaps for readers selecting reasoning-data and evaluation work.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Foundation LLMs can answer routine prompts quickly, but the paper argues that their heuristic, System-1-like behavior is inadequate for multi-step mathematics, coding, planning, and multimodal reasoning. Reported reasoning systems also use incompatible search, reward, training, and evaluation settings, so fragmented literature makes construction routes and performance claims hard to compare. This can lead readers to attribute differences in models, data, or test-time budgets to a method itself, and makes reusable data or verification choices harder.

The paper addresses this as a survey rather than a new training method: it connects early System-2 technologies to reasoning LLMs, organizes construction methods, benchmark categories, and metrics, compares reported model results, and maintains a companion literature index for later audit.

基础大模型能快速回答常规问题，但论文认为其近似 System 1 的启发式行为难以胜任多步数学、代码、规划和多模态推理；不同推理系统又采用不兼容的搜索、奖励、训练和评测设置，分散文献使构建路线与性能结论难以比较。这会使读者把模型、数据或测试时预算差异误归因于方法本身，也难以据此选择可复用的数据或验证机制。

论文以综述而非新训练方法处理该问题：把早期 System 2 技术与推理大模型连成脉络，整理构建方法、基准类别、指标和已报告的模型结果，并维护供后续审计的配套文献索引。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core contribution is a System-1-to-System-2 map of reasoning LLMs: historical foundations, model behavior, five construction-method families, benchmarks, metrics, reported performance, and research gaps are placed in one taxonomy. It changes the focus from a single route such as RL or test-time scaling to the interaction among search, reward modeling, self-improvement, macro actions, and reinforcement fine-tuning, while separating capability reports from the benchmarks used to assess them.

No official downloadable dataset is released, and the paper does not construct a unified experimental corpus. Its output is a reading framework and paths to entries, not a cleaned dataset with a fixed schema, license, and sampling protocol that can be traced and checked. The companion GitHub repository is a maintained resource index, not a training corpus or executable reproduction package.

核心贡献是以 System 1 到 System 2 为线索建立推理大模型地图：把历史基础、模型行为、五类构建方法、基准、指标、已报告性能与研究缺口放入同一分类。它不只围绕 RL 或测试时扩展，而是并列考察搜索、奖励建模、自我改进、宏动作和强化微调如何配合，同时把能力报告与评测它们的基准区分开来。

论文未发布官方可下载数据集，也未构造统一实验语料；其产出是阅读框架和条目路径，不是具有固定字段、许可和采样协议、可追溯核验的清洗数据对象。配套 GitHub 是持续维护的文献资源索引，不是训练语料，也不是可执行复现包。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Set the scope. The survey treats complex multi-step problems with intermediate reasoning as its target and distinguishes foundational from reasoning LLMs; its literature-search query, inclusion rule, and cutoff are not disclosed.
  1. Build the historical frame. It relates foundational LLMs to symbolic logic, Monte Carlo tree search, and reinforcement learning, producing the System-1-to-System-2 narrative used by later sections.
  1. Classify construction. It groups representative work under structure search, reward modeling, self-improvement, macro action, and reinforcement fine-tuning, and records model behavior and evolutionary stages.
  1. Map evaluation. It sorts benchmarks into math, code, science, agent, medical, and multimodal tasks; it then associates task and technical routes with metrics such as Pass@k, RM@k, Best-of-N, and efficiency measures.
  1. Compare and update. It collates reported scores into text and multimodal tables, states future challenges, and points to the GitHub index for updates. Reproduction requires fixing the arXiv version and manually checking cited protocols because score normalization, model budgets, and selection procedure are not fully disclosed.

1. 确定范围：以含中间步骤的复杂多步问题为对象，区分基础模型与推理模型；文献检索式、纳入规则和截止日期均未披露。
  1. 建立历史框架：把基础模型与符号逻辑、蒙特卡洛树搜索、强化学习连接，产出后续各节采用的 System 1 到 System 2 脉络。
  1. 分类构建路线：按结构搜索、奖励建模、自我改进、宏动作、强化微调归纳代表工作，并记录模型行为和演化阶段。
  1. 映射评测：将基准分为数学、代码、科学、智能体、医疗、多模态，并把 Pass@k、RM@k、Best-of-N 与效率指标对应到任务和技术路线。
  1. 比较并更新：汇集文本和多模态分数表，提出挑战并链接 GitHub 索引。复现需固定 arXiv 版本并逐项核查被引协议，因为分数归一化、模型预算和筛选过程未完全披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Coverage evidence — Section II explicitly organizes the survey around historical foundations, reasoning-model features, five construction-method families, benchmark categories/metrics/performance comparisons, adjacent techniques, and future directions. Section IV names six benchmark task categories and associates them with task- and method-level metrics. The companion repository mirrors this breadth with sections for o1 replication, process reward models, RL, tree search, self-improvement, reflection, efficiency, benchmarks, safety, and multimodal reasoning. This supports the card's claim that the paper is a field map, not a single-method report.

Comparative evidence — Table III places basic and reasoning LLMs side by side on seven text benchmarks, including AIME 2024, MATH-500, LiveCodeBench, Codeforces, SWE Verified, MMLU, and GPQA-Diamond; Table IV does the analogous job for MMMU, MathVista, MathVision, and OlympiadBench. The tables support locating reported results, but not causal claims that any one training recipe caused a difference: models, versions, data, and inference budgets differ.

覆盖证据：第 II 节明确依次组织历史基础、推理模型特征、五类构建方法、基准类别与指标及性能比较、相邻技术和未来方向。第 IV 节列出六类基准任务，并把它们对应到任务级和方法级指标。配套仓库也分列 o1 复现、过程奖励模型、RL、树搜索、自我改进、反思、效率、基准、安全和多模态推理，支持其“领域地图”定位，而非单一方法报告。

比较证据：表 III 并列基础与推理模型在 AIME 2024、MATH-500、LiveCodeBench、Codeforces、SWE Verified、MMLU、GPQA-Diamond 七项文本基准上的结果；表 IV 同样汇集 MMMU、MathVista、MathVision、OlympiadBench。它们可用于定位已报告分数，却不能证明某一训练配方造成差异，因为模型版本、数据和推理预算不同。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Nearby surveys commonly concentrate on test-time compute or reinforced reasoning, while technical reports often explain one o1-replication route. This paper instead makes the System-1-to-System-2 transition its organizing claim: it adds early symbolic logic, MCTS, and RL as predecessors, then uses five construction families to connect them to modern reasoning LLMs.

Its distinctive change is the breadth of the comparison frame and its link between historical roots, construction, and evaluation—not a new algorithm, dataset, or controlled evaluation. This lets readers locate a claim simultaneously by its precursor, training route, and test surface, but does not remove incompatibilities among the underlying reports or make them uniform. The maintained repository extends the survey as a living index, while the paper itself remains the citable fixed snapshot.

相近综述常聚焦测试时算力或强化推理，技术报告也常只解释一条 o1 复现路线；本文则以 System 1 到 System 2 的转变为组织主张，补入符号逻辑、蒙特卡洛树搜索和强化学习等早期前身，再用五类构建方法把它们连到现代推理大模型。

真正变化的是把历史根源、构建与评测连在一起的比较框架广度，不是新算法、数据集或受控评测。这让读者可同时按前身、训练路线和测试面定位主张，却不能消除或统一原始报告之间的不可比性。持续维护的仓库把它延展为动态索引，而论文文本仍是可引用的固定快照。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Author-stated limitation — The future-directions section identifies long autoregressive inference as a latency and efficiency problem, notes that smaller models struggle to match slow-thinking performance, and says current systems do not reliably switch between fast and deliberate modes. Reuse should record task difficulty and inference-token budget rather than treating “reasoning” as uniformly beneficial.

Curator audit risk — The review does not disclose a systematic search protocol, inclusion/exclusion rule, score normalization procedure, or a unified evaluation budget. Its tables aggregate results reported by different model providers; before comparing entries, inspect each cited benchmark version, prompting/scoring rule, and test-time budget.

Curator audit risk — The GitHub list changes after the paper snapshot. Use the paper for a stable claim and log the repository commit/date when using it as a discovery source.

作者指出的局限：未来方向部分将长自回归推理列为延迟与效率问题，说明小模型难以达到慢思考表现，且现有系统不能稳定切换快速与审慎模式。复用时应记录任务难度和推理 token 预算，不能把“推理”视为一概有利。

整理者审计风险：综述未披露系统检索协议、纳入排除规则、分数归一化方式或统一评测预算；表格汇集不同模型方报告的结果。比较条目前，应核查各被引基准版本、提示与计分规则及测试时预算。

整理者审计风险：GitHub 列表会在论文快照后继续变化。应以论文支持稳定主张，若将仓库用于检索，则记录所用提交或访问日期。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For a researcher choosing a reasoning-data or post-training route, start with a target task and fixed evaluation budget, use the five-family taxonomy to shortlist search, reward, self-improvement, macro-action, or reinforcement-fine-tuning work, and output a traceable reading list. Success is a shortlist whose cited papers share the required task and verification setting; do not treat the taxonomy as a recipe.

For an evaluator designing a suite, begin with a stated capability claim, map it to the paper's math, code, science, agent, medical, or multimodal categories and metrics, then create a protocol sheet containing benchmark version and budget. The output is an auditable evaluation plan. Do not reuse the score tables as a normalized leaderboard.

For literature discovery, use the companion repository to find recent entries, but verify each primary paper and pin a repository date or commit before reporting coverage.

若要选择推理数据或后训练路线，先固定目标任务和评测预算，再用五类分类筛选搜索、奖励、自我改进、宏动作或强化微调工作，输出可追溯的阅读清单。成功标准是入选论文具有相同任务与验证条件；不能把该分类直接当作配方。

若要设计评测套件，先写明能力主张，再映射到数学、代码、科学、智能体、医疗或多模态类别及指标，并建立含基准版本和预算的协议表，输出可审计的评测计划。不能把分数表直接复用为归一化排行榜。

若用于文献发现，可从配套仓库找近期条目，但报告覆盖范围前必须核验每篇主论文，并固定仓库的提交或访问日期。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position — It answers fragmented reasoning-LLM literature with a System-1-to-System-2 field map, not a training recipe or a new model claim.
  1. Method handle — Read construction through five families: structure search, reward modeling, self-improvement, macro action, and reinforcement fine-tuning; its historical bridge is symbolic logic, MCTS, and RL. The paper does not disclose a systematic review protocol.
  1. Artifact handle — The official GitHub repository is a maintained resource index with method and benchmark lists. No official downloadable training dataset or executable reproduction package is released with the survey.
  1. Evidence anchor — Table III covers seven text benchmarks and Table IV four multimodal benchmarks; Section IV also gives six task categories. Underlying models and inference budgets vary, so use the tables for source tracing, not causal ranking.
  1. Reuse decision — Best for scoping a reading or evaluation plan. Before reuse, pin the arXiv version, repository date/commit, and every cited benchmark's version, prompt, metric, and test-time budget.

1. 定位：论文用 System 1 到 System 2 的领域地图回应分散的推理模型文献，不提供训练配方，也不提出新模型性能主张。
  1. 方法抓手：按结构搜索、奖励建模、自我改进、宏动作、强化微调五类阅读，其历史桥梁是符号逻辑、蒙特卡洛树搜索和强化学习；论文未披露系统综述协议。
  1. Artifact 抓手：官方 GitHub 是含方法与基准条目的持续维护资源索引；综述未随文发布可下载训练数据或可执行复现包。
  1. 证据锚点：表 III 覆盖七项文本基准，表 IV 覆盖四项多模态基准，第 IV 节还列出六类任务；底层模型和推理预算不同，应只用于溯源，不能用于因果排序。
  1. 复用决定：适合界定阅读或评测计划；复用前固定 arXiv 版本、仓库日期或提交，以及每项被引基准的版本、提示、指标和测试时预算。
